messages:
Keisha: Quick sync  we need a short compatibility note and a tiny shim doc for customers who can't migrate immediately from v1 -> v2. Aim: publish the note + ship the shim examples by Friday.
Tom: I can draft the compatibility note. It should explain the minimal behavioural diffs: call shape, response structure, and model-id changes.
Arman: I'll add a small example shim script and two tested snippets (node, python) that map old `client.invoke` to `client.responses.create` and provide `getText(res)` helper. Keep it opt-in and behind a clear comment.
Keisha: Important: do not promote the shim as long-term; call it 'migration bridge' and include a sunset date. Also add instructions to run `grep -R \"client.invoke(\"` to find local usages.
docs-bot: Created PR templates: website PRs should include `migration-summary` in the body and tag `docs/migration-bridge`.
Translation: Mark changed strings with `i18n:needs-review`. We'll batch translate once merges land.
Compliance: Please include a line in the note that examples must not contain PII. We'll add a checklist item in the PR template.
QA: I'll run snippet smoke against staging and validate the shim examples behave identically for simple prompts. Report back by EOD.
Tom: Draft note excerpt:
"The v2 Responses API replaces the legacy v1 invoke endpoint. Most user code will need to update call sites and adapt to the new structured response shape. For a short migration period we provide a migration bridge shim that maps old calls to the new API and exposes a small helper to extract plain text. We recommend migrating fully to v2 as soon as feasible; the shim will be maintained only for the next 90 days."
Arman: Shim usage example (docs-only):
```js
// MIGRATION BRIDGE (opt-in)
import { migrationBridge } from '@redwood/docs-utils'
const client = migrationBridge(new RedwoodClient())
await client.invoke({ model: 'r-assist', prompt: 'Summarize' })
// behind the scenes it calls responses.create and maps outputs
```
Keisha: Good. Add a one-line rollout playbook: find callsites, run shim, swap snippets, remove shim.
docs-bot: PRs opened: 2 (shim + compatibility note). Labels: `docs/migration-bridge`, `needs-qa`.
QA: Smoke results: shim examples pass for basic text responses; filed one issue for function-call mapping edge-case.
Keisha: Resolve the edge-case before publishing but go ahead with publishing the note draft to /docs/news as 'preview'. Tag internal support so they can answer questions.
Tom: Will post the preview and include links to the shim PR and the full migration guide.
Translation: Received flags; will schedule translation run after final merge.
Compliance: Approved wording for PII checklist.
Keisha: Thanks all  will close this thread after legal confirms the preview wording. If anyone spots leftover `invoke` references, paste paths here.
